description: Grade 5 optional enrichment example: rewrite one bar from 2/4 to 6/8.

provenance.authoredBy: Music Theory Path curriculum team (Brief 10 addendum)

item.prompt: Rewrite this bar of 2/4 in 6/8 so every note and rest keeps the same share of its beat. Beam by the new beats.

music.textAlternative: One bar of 2/4 (two crotchet beats), unpitched rhythm on a single line.

hints: 2/4 has two crotchet beats; 6/8 has two dotted-crotchet beats. Match each beat to its partner.

feedback.correct: Correct. A crotchet beat in 2/4 becomes a dotted crotchet beat in 6/8, so every value gains a dot: a crotchet becomes a dotted crotchet, and the two quavers become two dotted quavers sharing the second beat.

mistakes.values-copied-unchanged: Copying the values leaves a bar of the wrong length for 6/8. Compare one beat in each time signature first.
mistakes.rest-not-rewritten: A rest fills the same share of the beat as a note, so it changes in exactly the same way.
mistakes.dots-kept-in-simple-time: A simple beat is undotted, so the dots must come off when going from compound to simple time.
mistakes.beam-across-beats: Start a new beam on each new beat so the beats stay visible.

feedback.fallback: A crotchet beat in 2/4 becomes a dotted crotchet beat in 6/8, so every value gains a dot: a crotchet becomes a dotted crotchet, and the two quavers become two dotted quavers sharing the second beat.
